title: Usiphu Medical Question Bank Registry
scope: Medical education and clinical examination preparation only.

accepted_formats: A JSON array of MCQ objects
A JSON object with bank_id, title, and questions array

supported_question_types.single_best_answer: Implemented in the current learner question-bank interface.
supported_question_types.extended_matching: Model type reserved; learner interaction still to be implemented.
supported_question_types.short_answer: Model type reserved; learner interaction still to be implemented.

editorial_policy.publication_rule: Only qualified human clinical review and local faculty/exam validation can promote items. Automated checks never approve clinical content.
editorial_policy.provenance_rule: Retain original author/source attribution and licence. Do not import copyrighted commercial question-bank dumps without permission.

current_content.note: Three starter questions plus 17 evidence-checked pilot MCQs (9 Urology, 8 General Surgery). All remain draft and are excluded from scored accuracy until qualified human clinical/faculty sign-off. All selected source pages were visually checked against rendered PDFs; source annotations are not treated as proof of answer correctness.

installed_banks.title: USIPHU Pilot Question Bank — General Surgery

pilot_governance.answer_basis: Open-access clinical guidelines, government health information and open-access medical literature, cited per question.
